_comment: The test locale (GAP#L11): pseudo-localisation, never offered to players.
Run with COLOURWARS_LOCALE=qps-ploc. Each line of copy is wrapped in [ ],
so a cut-off or unlocalised string shows at a glance; the strings it leaves
out are ones with no room for two more characters, and fall back to

help.controls:
[CONTROLLER]
[Move / drop: left stick]
[Aim: right stick    Shoot: {pad_shoot}]
[Jump: {pad_jump} (hold for height)]
[Pause: {pad_pause}    Debug: Back / View]
[KEYBOARD + MOUSE]
[Move: {left} / {right}    Drop: {drop} / Down]
[Aim: mouse cursor    Shoot: {shoot}]
[Jump: {jump} (hold for height)]
[Pause: {pause}    Debug: F1]
[MENUS]
[Navigate: stick / D-pad / arrows]
[Select: A / Enter    Back: B / Esc]
[AIM / READINESS]
[Direction only; roller aim is fixed.]
[Ready: chevron / Cooldown: bars]
[No paint: cross]
[Pad sticks: movement / aim deadzones.]
[REDUCE EFFECTS]
[Less shake, flashes and idle detail.]

keyboard_jump.heading: [Keyboard Keys]
keyboard_jump.help:
[Select a row, then press its new key.]
[Use one A-Z key or Space;]
[Shoot may also take a mouse button.]
[One key does one action;]
[keys in use are refused.]
[Esc always pauses and Down always drops.]
[Apply activates and saves your keys.]
[Back discards unapplied changes.]
[Menus and intro skip keep their fixed keys.]

pad_buttons.heading: [Pad Buttons]
pad_buttons.help:
[Choose Jump, Shoot and Pause for this]
[pad, each with an optional second control.]
[One control does one action per pad;]
[controls in use are skipped.]
[LS / RS mean pressing a stick in.]
[Apply saves edited pads.]
[Back discards unapplied changes.]
[Menus and intro skip keep A / B / Start.]
[Profiles follow Pad 1-4 slots.]

profiles.heading: [Profiles]
profiles.name: [Name]
profiles.help:
[A profile carries one person's stick]
[deadzones, rumble, comfort switches,]
[pad buttons and Boost from pad to pad.]
[Wear it on Join Players with X/R,]
[or choose a pad under Worn by.]
[While a pad wears a profile, Pad sticks]
[and Pad buttons edit the profile.]
[New profile copies the pressing pad.]
[Wearing lasts until the game closes.]

weapon_descriptions.sprayer:
[Fires a powerful stream of paint in an arc pattern.]
[Good for beginners.]
weapon_descriptions.sniper:
[Slowly fires powerful, accurate shots.]
[Can dispatch players quickly if you have skill.]
weapon_descriptions.roller:
[Rolls paint in a wide area in front of you.]
[Can be used to cover large floor areas quickly.]
weapon_descriptions.mister: [Produces a mist of slow-moving, diffusing paint particles.]
weapon_descriptions.bucket:
[Throws a bucket of paint in a short arc pattern.]
[Ideal for defeating other players.]
weapon_descriptions.random:
[Randomly selects a weapon for you.]
[Indecisiveness is nothing to be ashamed of.]
